behavior_constraints: RCM must handle disconnected graphs by processing each connected component independently with pseudo-peripheral start and degree-ordered traversal
Each component's Cuthill-McKee ordering must be reversed independently before concatenating into the final permutation
Components must be concatenated in order of their smallest node index (component containing lowest-index node first)
GMRES(m) restarted solver must be available as `--solver gmres`
A `--restart <m>` parameter with default 30 must control the Krylov subspace dimension before restart
On restart, GMRES must use the current approximate solution as the new initial guess and recompute the residual
GMRES must check relative residual estimate against tol after each Krylov step and return updated solution when below tolerance
GMRES `--history` must print one line per inner iteration across all restart cycles with globally sequential numbering starting at 1
GMRES `iterations` output must be the total number of Krylov steps across all restarts
GMRES true residual reporting and `converged` field must behave identically to CG and BiCGSTAB
entities.summary: This round fixes RCM reordering to handle disconnected matrices by processing each connected component independently with component-wise reversal, and adds a restarted GMRES(m) solver with a `--restart` parameter, convergence/history semantics matching CG/BiCGSTAB, and preconditioner support plus dedicated error handling.
